subject.title: fix(transcript): keep pagination cursors out of secret masking on resume

question: May OpenClaw treat generic tool-call fields named `page_token` or `page_cursor` as replay-safe across all tools, despite those names also being used for credentials by external APIs?
rationale: The requested behavior is valid for pagination, but the current redactor has no demonstrated per-tool semantic contract that distinguishes a pagination cursor from an opaque credential with the same field name.

options.title: Add a typed cursor classification
options.body: Preserve cursor values only when the producing tool/schema explicitly marks that argument as replay-safe pagination state, while retaining default key-based redaction for every other token-shaped field.

options.title: Keep the generic allowlist
options.body: Accept that tool arguments named `page_token` or `page_cursor` may be retained in persisted transcript context even when a provider uses those names for credentials.

options.title: Pause for the canonical replay design
options.body: Avoid a partial exception and resolve cursor and credential replay through the broader durable design tracked by the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Add a typed cursor classification
recommendation.body: Preserve cursor values only when the producing tool/schema explicitly marks that argument as replay-safe pagination state, while retaining default key-based redaction for every other token-shaped field.
